summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ERP system. Backend APIs are mostly functional (11/13 tests passed) but critical frontend-backend integration issues prevent data display. All 5 ERP pages load correctly but show empty data despite backend returning valid responses.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 500 error when creating new employee

critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot see any ERP data (invoices, purchase orders, etc.)

critical_bugs.issue: Persistent tour modal appears on every page and cannot be dismissed properly

integration_issues.issue: Frontend components not properly consuming API responses - KPIs show 0.00 € despite backend returning valid data
403 errors and loading timeouts on CRM and HR pages

All 5 ERP pages load with correct routing

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix frontend-backend integration - API data is not being displayed in the UI. The backend APIs work correctly but frontend components show empty states. Also fix persistent onboarding tour modal and employee creation 500 error.
